svg.title: Input and selection — Truecolor / Ocean · page 2/2
svg.desc: Editable fields, forms, lists and focused choices. Actual ratatui buffer renders: form, list, list-scrolling, list-tall-rows, list-long, list-empty, empty-state, empty-state-small
